verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents three ways to onboard merchants: an embeddable Merchant Onboarding Component (recommended), the Platform Portal, and a direct API with a create-merchant endpoint [21][5][4][35]. The API path accepts sensitive data such as bank accounts and SSNs [31], bank linking is validated in real time through Plaid [29], and pre-submission underwriting verifications plus a 'Needs Information' status cover the KYB/KYC side [30][37]. Direct-API onboarding is limited to platforms Rainforest approves, and evidence for KYB vs. KYC and hosted flows is thinner than for the core component and API path. Missing for 10: any evidence of terms-of-service acceptance capture, explicit KYB vs. KYC detail, a merchant-facing hosted onboarding link (the portal is platform-operated), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
